name: PNP transistor (2N2907)
description: A small PNP transistor used as a high-side switch: it conducts from the emitter (E) to the collector (C) when the base (B) is pulled at least 0.6 V below E. Connect E to the supply (5V), drive B through a 1kΩ resistor (LOW = on) and put the load between C and GND. Switching model only (no amplification).
